title: Features
lead: Feature toggles for config/features.ini. Loaded after config/board.ini — these values override gesture and twist settings from the board file (useful for contest-specific SD cards).
feature.gesture.label: Gesture ignition
feature.gesture.description: When on, motion gestures (swing, thrust, or twist) can ignite the blade without pressing the activation switch. When off, the saber only turns on from the button.
feature.twistOn.label: Twist to turn on
feature.twistOn.description: When on, rotating the hilt in the twist-on gesture powers the saber on. When off, twist cannot be used to ignite — useful if you want button-only activation.
feature.twistOff.label: Twist to turn off
feature.twistOff.description: When on, a twist gesture shuts the saber down. When off, twist-off is disabled — a common contest setting so the blade cannot be turned off accidentally during performance.
